claims.text: The assistant handles repetitive activities such as gathering information on topics, examination modes, and question formulations from students, which saves time for tutors.
The assistant executes routine tasks that are ordinarily performed in customer support, allowing workers to focus on more complex tasks.
The assistant reduces waiting times for students by processing their questions more efficiently, thus minimizing repetitive interactions.
